text:
This week's garden got more drawers. MCP added tools for papers, media, packages, and calculations. Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash added 3 to 15 second video with audio; Wan 3.0 gained a 2 to 15 second range, and Flare can make GIFs. Three paid-only ElevenLabs models and Claude Fable 5.2 joined too.

Enter reorganized Agents, MCP, keys, sandboxes, and docs. If the legacy image limiter fails, uncached requests now get a 503 with Retry-After: 10; cached images remain available. Also, 28 community apps joined the catalog. Browse at pollinations.ai.
